sources.claim: Malwarebytes reports Vidar was analyzed as an Arkei copycat/forked stealer.
SANS ISC describes Vidar as a copycat or fork of Arkei malware.

curator_note: Accepted as forked_from because multiple public sources use fork/base language. Confidence remains medium until the primary Fumik0_ analysis is recorded directly.
confidence_reason: Multiple public sources align on Vidar being Arkei-based, but the strongest technical source is referenced indirectly rather than stored as a source record.
